01 / A note to Chandra

We came for
the house.
We stayed for
the story.

Hi Chandra,

What drew us to Two Palms West was the feeling that someone had cared deeply about every corner. Learning that you shaped the house yourself made us want to know more.

We’re two independent creatives working across websites, photography and film. We’d love to bring our skills together around a place we feel connected to — and make something useful for the person who created it.

Our idea is a creative exchange: we build a considered online home for Two Palms West, with new images and a short film. You welcome us into the space to create it, and we share the finished work as a portfolio project.

From one creative endeavour to another.
02 / What we could make

One place.
Three ways to feel it.

A small, cohesive body of work that helps people discover the house, understand its character and find their way to a booking.

01

A digital home.

A distinctive onepage website that brings the spaces, your story and the booking journey together.

  • Responsive desktop & mobile design
  • Space galleries and founder story
  • Existing booking links, clearly placed
  • Launch handover & a simple update guide
02

A moving portrait.

A short film that lets visitors experience the light, rhythm and personality of Two Palms West.

  • One proposed 60–90 second house film
  • Three short vertical edits
  • Natural sound & carefully chosen music
  • Your presence or voice, if you’d like
03

A fresh perspective.

A photography collection made for the website, social channels and future location enquiries.

  • Proposed selection of 20–30 edited images
  • Wide spaces, intimate details, atmosphere
  • An optional founder portrait session
  • Web-ready & high-resolution exports

A starting scope for discussion, shaped together around your priorities and our shoot plan.

03 / Film direction

A day at
Two Palms West.

A quiet, human portrait. Gentle movement, tactile details and the sound of a place coming to life.

01 / 00–15 seconds

The house wakes.

A door opens. Sunlight moves across the patio. We arrive slowly, with space to notice the textures and shadows.

Sound direction: birds, a door opening, footsteps.

Interactive storyboard using existing reference photographs. The proposed film has not been produced.

05 / A creative exchange

Something valuable.
For both of us.

For Two Palms West

A complete, connected story.

The agreed website, photographs and film, created without a creative-service fee. A collection you can use across your own website, social channels and location listings.

A clearer way for prospective clients to get a feel for the space and find the information they need.

For us

A place to create something real.

Agreed access to the house for a small, carefully planned shoot, with the location fee exchanged for the creative work.

Permission to show the agreed final work on our portfolios and social channels, with clear credits for Two Palms West.

01 / Connect

A short conversation about your priorities, the house and what would make this useful to you.

02 / Shape & create

Agree on the deliverables, shoot access, timing and usage. Then develop the work around one shared direction.

03 / Review & launch

Review the website and final edits together, refine the details, then hand over and launch when ready.

Before scheduling, we would also agree on any outside costs, such as hosting, music licensing, permits or insurance where required. Nothing beyond the agreed scope is assumed.

Made with care. Made together.

You’ve made a place
with a point of view.
We’d love to help share it.

A starting point for a conversation, from two independent creatives.

This is an independent collaboration proposal, not an approved partnership or a live replacement website.
